error.local-auth-remote-server: Local Windows sign-in is unavailable for a remote Server. Use a password or OIDC instead.
error.local-auth-unavailable: The local Windows sign-in channel is unavailable. Verify that Server is running and the current account is linked.
serverprofile.delete-impact: This only removes the local connection profile. It does not stop Server, Agent, or instances, and it does not delete server data.
danger.unregister-impact: Only the instance registration, related schedules, and grants will be removed. The working directory {0} and all of its files will be preserved.
danger.forcestop-impact: Force stop terminates the entire process tree immediately and may corrupt world data that has not been written to disk.
danger.delete-directory-impact: The Servitium-managed working directory {0} will be deleted recursively. This cannot be undone; the server always rejects external registered directories.
danger.delete-user-impact: The user and their sessions, API keys, and instance grants will be removed. This cannot be undone.
danger.rotate-token-impact: Existing private Channel addresses will stop working immediately. Players must reinstall or reconfigure with an address containing the new token.
danger.publish-delete-impact: This publication contains deletions ({0}). The corresponding player files will be removed on update; review the difference before continuing.
terminal.window-limit: Up to 8 independent terminal windows can be open at once. Close an existing window first.
editor.unsaved-impact: Leaving this page discards content that has not been saved from the editor. This cannot be undone.
transfer.drop-caption: Drop to add to the current task
transfer.drop-ready: The dropped archive is selected; review the fields, then run the corresponding action.
settings.restart-required: This setting takes effect after Server restarts.
danger.oidc-impact: Changing the OIDC issuer, client, or identity mapping can prevent bound users from signing in. Confirm that a recovery path is available.
tray.close-explanation: Servitium will keep running in the system tray. Server, Agent, and Minecraft instances will not stop. You can change this behavior in local settings.
tray.exit-confirmation: Only the Desktop client will exit. Server, Agent, and Minecraft instances will continue running. Continue?

danger.sync-content-impact: The instance must be stopped. Servitium will create a backup and apply the configured channel release.
danger.delete-schedule-impact: Type the scheduled task name to permanently delete the task and its future executions.
danger.rotate-node-credential-impact: The current Agent credential becomes invalid immediately and the node must reconnect with the new credential.
danger.remove-node-impact: This node currently has {0} listed instance registrations. Removing the node keeps those registrations and disconnects the Agent.
danger.delete-java-files-impact: This runtime is used by {0} instances. Only Servitium-imported runtime files can be deleted.
danger.unregister-java-impact: This runtime is used by {0} instances. In-use runtimes are rejected and files are retained.
danger.revoke-all-sessions-impact: All active sessions for this user become invalid immediately.
danger.unbind-identity-impact: The external identity will no longer be accepted for this account. Ensure another sign-in method remains available.
danger.remove-totp-impact: Two-step verification and all recovery codes will be removed. Active sessions may be revoked.
danger.revoke-session-impact: The selected session becomes invalid immediately.
danger.reset-dashboard-impact: Your dashboard card layout will be restored to the product default.
danger.delete-channel-impact: The channel will be removed asynchronously. Immutable content is reclaimed only according to retention rules.
danger.change-visibility-impact: Changing visibility alters client access. Switching to token protection requires distributing the new installation link.
error.operation-timeout: The operation did not complete within the local wait limit. Check the Operations page for its final state.
danger.enable-advanced-commands-impact: Advanced raw commands bypass the structured launch wizard. The first argument is still restricted to a registered java.exe, but incorrect arguments can damage instance data.
danger.non-loopback-listen-impact: Non-loopback exposure requires trusted TLS or an explicitly trusted reverse proxy. Incorrect settings can expose the control plane.
node.registration.one-time-message: The plaintext token is shown only once. It cannot be viewed again after this dialog is closed; revoke it and create a new token if it is lost.
node.registration.agent-instructions: Prepare an isolated data directory on the target Windows node, then start Agent. Replace <ONE_TIME_TOKEN> in the command template with the token above. Agent stores its rotated node credential after successful first registration. A trusted HTTPS endpoint is required outside loopback.
instance.create.owned-message: This method creates a Servitium-managed working directory. Unregistering and deleting the directory remain separate actions.
instance.create.external-message: The directory remains maintained by its external owner. Servitium never recursively deletes an external working directory.
user.grants.safety-message: Instance grants immediately change which instances this user can access and apply consistently to REST, realtime events, file streams, and Agent commands. A bulk revocation can interrupt active operations; verify the user and every selected instance before submitting.
danger.revoke-grants-impact: Revoke user “{1}” from {0} instances. The change propagates immediately and may interrupt this user's active operations.
file.clipboard-ready: The selected items are ready in the file clipboard
danger.delete-files-impact: Delete the selected {0} files or directories. Agent revalidates every path and never crosses the instance working directory.

desktop.password-mismatch: The passwords do not match. Confirm your password again.

desktop.instance-crashed-next: The instance exited unexpectedly. Check recent console output and the exit code; if memory was exhausted, adjust maximum memory in instance settings and retry.
desktop.instance-summary: {0} running · {1} stopped · {2} need attention · {3}/{4} nodes online
desktop.force-stop-impact: Force stopping immediately ends the instance process. Unsaved game data may be lost. Continue?
desktop.instance-update-impact: The configured update will back up and replace instance content. Keep the instance stopped. Continue?
desktop.operation-queued: Operation submitted. Open ongoing operations in the title bar to see progress; status updates automatically.
desktop.no-instances-next: No matching instances. Adjust the filters. Administrators can create an instance; other users can request access from an administrator.

desktop.create-managed-directory: The node will create a managed working directory
desktop.create-review-help: Creation queues an operation, visible in the title bar. For an empty instance, upload server files and read and accept the Minecraft EULA before starting. Unregistering an attached directory keeps all files.
desktop.create-source-required: Choose a server ZIP or enter the absolute existing directory on the node to continue.
desktop.create-node-required: Choose an online node. Restore its connection if it is offline.
desktop.create-java-required: Choose Java registered on this node. If the list is empty, register Java from the node page first.
desktop.create-fields-required: Enter a name (up to 64 characters), relative launch target and stop command. Maximum memory must be at least minimum memory; the stop timeout is 1–600 seconds.
desktop.accept-eula: Read and accept the Minecraft EULA…
desktop.accept-eula-impact: Read the Minecraft EULA at https://www.minecraft.net/eula first. Confirming means you have read and accepted it; an acceptance record will be written in this instance’s working directory.
desktop.eula-required-next: The Minecraft EULA has not been accepted. Read and accept it from More options, then retry starting.
desktop.eula-accepted: EULA acceptance recorded. You can now start the instance.
desktop.console-command-disabled: Commands are available while the instance is running. Start the instance first.
desktop.address-not-reported: Player address and port are not configured

desktop.java-administrator-only: Uses registered Java; details are visible to administrators

desktop.metrics-not-running: Instance is not running; resource data is unavailable
desktop.players-query-unavailable: Player information is temporarily unavailable. Check the player query address and port in instance settings.
desktop.players-query-disabled: Player query is disabled. Configure its address and port in instance settings.
desktop.crash-memory-next: The instance exited unexpectedly ({0}, exit code {1}). Its output indicates insufficient memory. Increase maximum memory in instance settings and retry.
desktop.crash-exit-next: The instance exited unexpectedly ({0}, exit code {1}). Check recent output below, correct launch settings or server files, and retry.
desktop.console-output-empty: No recent output. Start the instance to see its live console here.
desktop.files-delete-impact:
Delete the selected files or subdirectories below? Their contents cannot be recovered. The working directory boundary remains in place.

desktop.files-overwrite-impact: Files at matching destination paths will be replaced and their original contents cannot be recovered. Check the current directory and destination name before continuing.
desktop.upload-no-files: The selected directory contains no regular files. You can create an empty directory at the destination manually.
desktop.archive-destination: ZIP file name or relative path
desktop.extract-destination: Extract to directory (blank for the current directory)
desktop.files-running-warning: The instance is not stopped. Stop it before changing files. Browsing and downloading remain available.
desktop.file-locked-next: The file is in use. Stop the instance, then retry replacing, saving or deleting it.
desktop.transfer-cleanup-failed: The transfer failed and its temporary parts could not be cleaned up. Check the node connection and storage space, and ask an administrator to inspect the incomplete upload.
desktop.collision-policy: When copying or moving to an existing name
desktop.collision-reject: Reject and keep the existing file
desktop.upload-overwrite: Allow replacing files during upload (confirmation required)
desktop.files-empty-next: No files here or no matching items. Upload files, create a directory, or adjust the filter.
desktop.files-boundary: File operations stay within this instance’s working directory. Drag regular files or folders from File Explorer to upload them.
desktop.unsaved-discard-impact: Leaving will discard your unsaved changes. Continue?
desktop.transfer-leave-impact: Leaving cancels the transfer before it is submitted. A merge operation already submitted to the server continues and is visible in Activity. Continue leaving?
desktop.instance-stop-required-next: The instance is not stopped. Stop it from the command bar, wait until its status is Stopped, and retry.
desktop.session-expired-next: Your session is invalid or has expired. Reconnect to the server and sign in again.
desktop.authorization-changed: Your session or permissions changed. Accessible instances have been reopened. Sign in again or ask an administrator to restore access.
desktop.config-value-invalid: Check {0}: numbers must be within {1}–{2}; other values must match the setting requirements.
desktop.config-raw-changed: Raw text changed. Saving creates an automatic backup.
desktop.config-conflict-next: Multiple candidate files were found for this configuration. Inspect their locations in Files, resolve the conflict, then scan again.
desktop.config-stop-first: The instance is not stopped. You can inspect configuration; stop it before editing or restoring a backup.
desktop.config-restart-needed: Configuration takes effect when the instance next starts. Saving creates a backup and preserves unchanged fields.
desktop.config-choose-next: Choose a configuration file. Use Files to open other files.
desktop.config-file-details: {0} · {1} · {2} other fields preserved in raw text
desktop.config-saved-next: Configuration saved with an automatic backup. Changes take effect at the next instance start.
desktop.config-restore-impact: Replace this configuration with the selected backup and discard unsaved edits. The current file is backed up first. Changes take effect at the next start.
desktop.config-empty-next: No supported configuration files found. Prepare the server files or open a file in Files, then scan again.
desktop.config-backups-description: Choose a backup time to restore. Revision checks are applied automatically when saving.
desktop.config-no-backups: No backups. A backup is created when you first save configuration.

desktop.config-concurrency-next: Another operation changed this content. Keep the edits you need, reload the current content, then save.
desktop.mods-select-next: Select a mod or plugin to inspect details or manage its file.
desktop.mod-metadata-unreadable: Metadata could not be read. Check that the JAR is complete; file management remains available.
desktop.mod-changed-next: File enabled state changed. It takes effect at the next instance start.
desktop.mod-delete-impact: Delete the file {1} for {0}. Related configuration is retained. This cannot be undone; download a backup from Files first.
desktop.mod-uploaded-next: Upload complete and the list rescanned. The file loads at the next instance start.
desktop.transfer-cancelled: Transfer or waiting stopped. If server merging already began, refresh to check the final result.
desktop.mods-running-next: Enabled changes take effect at the next start. Stop the instance before uploading or deleting; locked files may reject toggles.
desktop.mods-filter: Filter by name, author or identifier
desktop.mods-no-configuration: No related configuration found. Scan after the server creates configuration, or locate it in Files.
desktop.mods-empty-next: No matching mods or plugins. Clear filters, upload a JAR, or place files in the instance directory and scan again.
desktop.mods-boundary: Manages mods and plugins in this instance directory. Online search and downloads are not available here.
desktop.schedule-action-invalid: Add 1–10 valid actions. Commands must be a single line up to 4096 characters; delays must be 1–86400 seconds.
desktop.schedule-trigger-invalid: Use an interval of 10–31536000 seconds; choose at least one weekday and valid time for a calendar trigger, or a valid local date and time for a specified trigger.
desktop.schedule-no-next-run: Not scheduled; check enabled state, time and remaining runs
desktop.schedule-name-invalid: Enter a task name of up to 64 characters, without control characters.
desktop.schedule-runs-invalid: Remaining runs must be a positive integer or minus one for unlimited; choose a valid overlap policy.
desktop.schedule-force-impact: This action chain includes force stop and may lose unsaved game data. An enabled task will execute when triggered. Confirm you have a backup and understand the consequences.
desktop.schedule-saved-next: Scheduled task saved. The node executes enabled tasks when triggered; disabled tasks can still run manually.
desktop.schedule-run-completed: Task execution completed. Inspect history for individual action results.
desktop.schedule-run-failed-next: Task execution failed. Open its history, check instance state, action arguments and failure results, then retry.
desktop.schedule-delete-impact: Delete the task {0} and its future automatic runs. This cannot be undone and does not stop an already running instance process.
desktop.schedule-node-time: Use the node local time zone
desktop.schedule-client-time: Enter this computer local time; it is converted when saved. A past time will not run automatically.
desktop.schedule-continue-on-failure: Continue to the next action after failure
desktop.schedule-history-next: Refresh to read recent runs stored by the node. If there are none, run the task manually first.
desktop.schedules-empty-next: No scheduled tasks. Choose New task, set its trigger and actions in the side panel, then save.
desktop.protocol-response-error: The server response does not match this protocol. Check client and server versions, reconnect, then retry. Unsaved content is retained.
desktop.launch-memory-invalid: Memory must be whole MiB from 1 to 1048576, with maximum at least minimum.
desktop.launch-advanced-disabled: Advanced arguments are not allowed on this node. Turn advanced mode off, or check server and node policy and reload.
desktop.launch-arguments-invalid: Use a relative launch target and one nonempty argument per line, without control characters. Advanced mode needs at least one argument.
desktop.launch-environment-invalid: Environment variable names must be nonempty and unique, without equals signs or control characters. Values cannot contain a null character.
desktop.launch-advanced-help: The node directly starts registered Java and passes one argument per line. Node policy must allow this mode. No command interpreter is used.
desktop.launch-advanced-arguments: Advanced arguments (one per line, without the Java path)
desktop.launch-environment-help: Applies to this instance only. Values may contain credentials and are excluded from the launch preview. Windows variable names are case insensitive.
desktop.launch-preview: Launch preview (arguments, not a terminal script)
desktop.settings-name-invalid: Enter a nonempty name up to 64 characters and at most 32 tags, one per line.
desktop.settings-directory-invalid: Enter a fully qualified working directory on the node, without control characters.
desktop.settings-port-invalid: Leave the primary port empty or enter a whole number from 1 to 65535.
desktop.settings-lifecycle-invalid: Check lifecycle settings: stop timeout 1–600 seconds; startup delay and restart interval 0–600; restart attempts minus one to 100; reset time 60–86400 seconds.
desktop.settings-run-alias-invalid: The run account alias must be up to 64 characters without control characters. Register credentials on the node first.
desktop.settings-terminal-invalid: Use 20–500 columns and 5–200 rows, and choose a listed encoding and line ending.
desktop.settings-query-invalid: Query and remote console ports must be 1–65535 and the query host nonempty. Choose either a new password or clearing the password, without control characters.
desktop.settings-update-invalid: Choose an update action. For JAR replacement, enter two relative paths inside the instance directory; for content sync, select an existing channel.
desktop.settings-shortcuts-invalid: Use at most 20 shortcuts, with names up to 32 characters and nonempty single-line commands up to 1024 characters.
desktop.settings-change-directory-impact: Change the registered path to {0}. Files in {1} are not copied or moved and the old directory is retained. The new path is managed as external and never recursively deleted. Prepare its directory and server files on the node first.
desktop.settings-saved-next: Instance settings saved. Launch, terminal and connection options apply at the next start or related session opening.
desktop.settings-unregister-impact: Remove registration and related settings for {0}. Unsaved changes are not applied. The working directory {1} and all files are retained without deleting the directory.
desktop.settings-confirm-name: Enter the full instance name to continue
desktop.settings-name-confirm-mismatch: The name did not match. Nothing was deleted; check the intended instance.
desktop.settings-delete-directory-impact: Permanently delete the managed directory {0} and all its content, then remove registration. This cannot be undone; download a backup first. Only directories owned by Servitium are eligible; external directories are always rejected.
desktop.settings-owned-directory: Servitium owns this directory. Changing the path does not move files; the new path becomes external.
desktop.settings-external-directory: External working directory, never recursively deleted. Changing its registered path does not move files.
desktop.settings-java-help: Only Java registered on this node is available. Manage node Java if a required version is missing.
desktop.settings-memory-help: In MiB; takes effect at the next start.
desktop.settings-stop-help: Send this single-line command through the instance console, then wait for the process to exit.
desktop.settings-auto-start-help: Start this instance after the configured delay when Agent starts. Saving does not immediately start it.
desktop.settings-restart-attempts: Consecutive restart limit (minus one unlimited, zero no retry)
desktop.settings-run-alias-help: Use an alias for credentials registered locally on the node. Windows account passwords are not entered or transmitted here.
desktop.settings-shortcuts-help: These buttons appear below console command input. Saved in list order, up to 20 items.
desktop.settings-conpty-help: Use the Windows pseudo console, or redirected pipes when disabled.
desktop.settings-query-help: Query Java server list status from the node network for player counts and version data. Game configuration is not changed.
desktop.settings-rcon-password-help: Leave empty to retain the saved password; existing values are not shown. Configure the game server with a matching RCON port and password separately.
desktop.settings-clear-rcon-password: Clear the saved remote console password
desktop.settings-update-help: After saving the update action, run it explicitly from the instance command bar. Mods and marketplace content are not installed automatically.
desktop.settings-unregister-help: Remove registration and related settings while retaining the working directory and its files. Stop the instance first.
desktop.settings-delete-directory-help: Stopped, managed instances only. Requires the full instance name and a second confirmation; this cannot be undone.
desktop.server-setting-invalid: {0} must be a whole number from {1} to {2}.
desktop.server-effect-restart: A server service restart is required for full effect.
desktop.secret-set: A secret is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or explicitly clear it below.
desktop.settings-discard: Unsaved changes will be discarded. Confirm to continue.
desktop.settings-backup-owner: Only the owner can create a database backup.
desktop.settings-server-denied: Server settings require administrator access. Local preferences and your account remain available.
desktop.settings-server-saved: Settings saved. Settings marked as requiring a restart take full effect after the service restarts.
desktop.settings-network-help: Listening, TLS and proxy changes affect everyone. Paths refer to the server. Test the certificate and plan a service restart. Non-loopback exposure requires TLS or a trusted proxy.
desktop.server-setting-userFileManagemen: Allow users to manage granted instance files
desktop.settings-oidc-failed: The identity provider could not be verified. Check its HTTPS address, discovery document and server outbound policy, then retry.
desktop.settings-tls-failed: Certificate validation failed. Check the PFX path on the server, password, validity and trust chain.
desktop.settings-backup-created: Database backed up as {0}, created {1}. The file is in the server data directory.
desktop.settings-diagnostics-saved: The redacted diagnostics archive was saved to the selected file.
desktop.settings-listen-invalid: Enter a valid IP address to listen on.
desktop.settings-exposure-invalid: A non-loopback address requires TLS or a trusted reverse proxy.
desktop.settings-session-invalid: The absolute session lifetime must exceed the idle lifetime.
desktop.settings-tls-incomplete: Provide the certificate file path or certificate store thumbprint.
desktop.settings-proxy-incomplete: Trusted proxy mode requires trusted proxy networks.
desktop.settings-oidc-incomplete: Identity sign-in requires an HTTPS provider address and client identifier.
desktop.local-settings-invalid: Check the selected options; terminal font size must be between 8 and 32.
desktop.local-appearance-saved: Local appearance saved and applied. The language takes effect when you reopen the app.
desktop.local-language-help: Reopen the app to use this language. The server default language stays unchanged.
desktop.local-terminal-help: Choose a font size from 8 to 32. Reopen the terminal to apply it.
desktop.local-close-tray: Close the window to the tray
desktop.settings-remove-connection-impac: Remove only the server address saved on this computer. The server, instances and data are preserved.
desktop.settings-add-connection: Add or connect to a server
desktop.settings-address-help: Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS address without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
desktop.settings-delete-connection-help: Switch to another server before removing the current connection. Keep at least one connection.
desktop.settings-scope-local: This group only affects the Servitium window on this computer.
desktop.settings-scope-server: This group changes the current server and affects everyone connected to it.
desktop.settings-scope-account: This group manages your account and security on the current server.
desktop.account-password-impact: Changing your password invalidates this session. You will need to sign in again. Unsaved profile changes will be discarded.
desktop.account-recovery-help: These recovery codes are shown once. Store them safely. Each code can be used once.
desktop.account-key-name-required: Enter a key name and try again.
desktop.account-key-once: This key is shown once. Save it now and do not share it.
desktop.account-revoke-key-impact: Revoking {0} stops programs using it from accessing the server.
desktop.account-signout-impact: Sign out of this server session and discard unsaved account edits. Services and instances continue running.
desktop.account-password-help: Use at least twelve characters and confirm the new password.
desktop.account-totp-help: Use an authenticator to generate codes and keep your recovery codes safe.
desktop.account-oidc-help: Linking uses your system browser. Identity provider sign-in must be enabled on the server.
desktop.account-keys-help: Create keys for automation and revoke them when no longer needed.
desktop.account-keys-empty: No keys. Create one if you need automated access.
desktop.account-sessions-help: Review current and other sign-ins, and revoke sessions you no longer use.
desktop.account-sessions-empty: No sessions returned. Refresh, or sign in again if your session expired.
desktop.node-offline-duration: No contact for about {0} hours {1} minutes; last seen {2}
desktop.config-reference-default: This setting is absent from the file. The built-in reference default is shown and is written only if you change it.
desktop.config-conflict-candidates:
Multiple candidate files were found. Keep the intended version using the file manager first:
{0}
desktop.retry-next-step: Check the input and permissions, refresh and retry. Contact an administrator if the problem continues.
desktop.crash-memory-contact: The instance exited unexpectedly ({0}, exit code {1}). Output indicates insufficient memory. Ask an administrator to review maximum heap settings before retrying.
desktop.secret-clear-conflict: Do not clear and replace a secret together. Choose one action.
desktop.server-reconnecting: The realtime server connection was interrupted and is reconnecting. Check the server and network, then refresh to confirm operation results after it recovers.
desktop.server-disconnected-next: The realtime server connection is disconnected. Check the server and network, select the current connection again in the title bar, then refresh to confirm operation results.
